items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Well, Handy played cornet and trombone. Jasper Taylor on drums.

ctx.x: Two clarinets, three fiddles, and what kind of other instruments?
Well, Handy played cornet and trombone. Jasper Taylor on drums. You could only use the snares. And I don't remember whether they had a tube or not. That's a long time ago.
